_note: Values confirmed against packages/shared/src/policy (audited 28 Jul 2026). age_bands and safety_flags below are the REAL backend enums, not placeholders. sport is free-text on the backend (exercises.sports) so these are just our working controlled list, not a hard enum yet. position has no backend table at all.

age_bands._note: Maps to exercises.age_bands TEXT[] (migration 026, written but NOT YET APPLIED to the DB). Empty array on an exercise = unrestricted, visible to all bands. A non-empty array is a WHITELIST -- only those bands see it.

sport._note: Backend column exercises.sports already exists as free-text TEXT[], no enum behind it. This list is our proposed controlled vocabulary for the UI, not yet enforced server-side.

position._note: No backend table exists for this at all. Sport-scoped, deferred to a later pass. Empty for every sport below on purpose.

movement_type._note: No dedicated column exists. Derivable from the existing movement_pattern/workout_roles fields already in the corpus -- may not need a new migration, just a mapping function.

difficulty._note: Derivable from existing classification.difficultyRank already in the corpus -- likely no new column needed.

structure._note: No dedicated column. Roughly derivable from existing workout_roles (warmup/cooldown) already in the corpus.

safety_flags._note: REAL enum from packages/shared/src/policy/policy.ts RestrictedTopic. Currently only checked against free-text chat messages (apps/backend/src/ai/coach/safety.ts) -- there is NO existing mapping from these to exercises or workouts. Tagging exercises with these is net-new plumbing, not filling in an existing gap.
